patches.title: Direct Sink After Pickup
patches.principle: After picking up a dirty object, go directly to the sink and clean it without detours.
patches.when_to_apply: When holding an object that needs cleaning.

patches.title: Skip Empty Containers
patches.principle: If you open a container and it is empty, close it and move on without re-examining.
patches.when_to_apply: After opening a container that contains nothing.

patches.title: Start Search on Countertops
patches.principle: When searching for a cleanable object, start with countertops before any other furniture.
patches.when_to_apply: When the target object is not immediately visible and it is a cleaning task.
